$comment: What the app may cost a reader, measured by AquaTomeUITests/PerformanceTests and checked by scripts/check-perf.py (ios.yml, job app) against the median of each test's runs, on the CI simulator (iPhone 17, iOS 26.5, Debug build). A budget only tightens: one raised says why in its reason (docs/governance.md, Mobile apps rule 5). Each first value is the first CI run's median plus headroom, rounded.

budgets.name: Launch to the first screen answering touches
budgets.reason: raised 2026-11-01 from 4.7 s: the same app launched in 2.45–4.86 s on hosted runners (2.45 on #312, 2.88, 3.44, 3.80, 3.90, 4.02 on main after #333, 4.16, 4.28, 4.61, and 4.86 on PR #333). #333 made no difference measured on one Mac: medians 1.467 and 1.445 s before it, 1.407 and 1.427 s after, runs interleaved on one simulator. Budget: the slowest seen ×1.25

budgets.name: CPU time flinging through 800 fish
budgets.reason: raised 2026-11-02 from 3.4 s: other runners again, not slower code. The same app measured 2.846 s on PR #383 (6956b0b8) and 3.466 s on main after it (5c64e307); #375 measured 2.873 s on its PR (b041bcc4) and 3.527 s on main after it (2cd2ee1d), where its only change runs when a test opens a web page, which this test doesn't. Launch rose on the same runners (5.21 and 5.86 s, against 3.79–4.62 s on the others). Hosted runners have now read 2.12–3.53 s with nothing in the fling changed. Raised on 2026-11-01 from 2.2 s for the same reason (1.44–2.72 s then). Budget: the slowest seen, 3.527 s, ×1.25. Next: measure the fling against a fixed piece of work on the same runner, so the runner's speed cancels out and a smaller slowdown is caught

budgets.name: Memory at its peak while flinging through 800 fish
budgets.reason: raised 2026-11-01 from 75,500 kB for the Tìm tab's home of shelves (#316): the commit before it and #316 measured on one Mac, 75,991 → 77,581 kB (CI: 74,537 → 76,438 kB). Not cards kept: every build levels off after two runs, and a list that reuses its rows measured the same (77,597 kB). A heap diff after the same flings by hand puts the rest in the home staying alive under the shelf: more SwiftUI types (+442 kB metadata, +306 kB method caches), their observation and closure records (about 0.9 MB), and the shelves' own copy of the items (+397 kB). Not a leak: twenty runs in one launch hold flat (69.3–69.6 and 69.9–70.1 MB in two launches), and the five-run measurement above rose in one step of about 6 MB, then held flat. Worth it: the owner asked for the site's home in the app. Budget: CI median 76,438 kB ×1.1

budgets.name: App size, as archived for the App Store (all files, before Apple's encryption and thinning)
budgets.reason: raised 2026-11-06 from 7510 kB for the tank volume tool (#400), with the app lead's OK: features the owner asked for, not a slip, and Release is already -Osize with whole-module optimisation, so there is no quick trim. CI's perf job readings: main at 222fcf89d 7195.6 kB (run 42224834144); #400 on that main 7296.8 kB (run 42225628268), +101.2 kB (TankVolumeView, Volume and VolumeForm, 56 strings in three languages); #530, the owner's dashboard, on the same main 7406.2 kB (run 42225139145), +210.6 kB, owner-only code that every reader downloads; #400 on main after #530 7523.9 kB (run 42241154069). The 10% of headroom set on 2026-11-04 (6829.4 kB) went to fish ID, the dashboard and this tool. Budget: 7523.9 kB ×1.1, rounded to 5 kB. Next: measure where the size goes (a link map per module) before the next raise. Before: raised 2026-11-03 from 3255 kB for the app icons a reader chooses (AppIconPicker, the owner's request; the app lead's OK): 32 alternate icons, home-screen sizes only (iPhone 60 pt @2x and @3x, iPad 76 and 83.5 pt @2x, no 1024). Measured on one Mac (Release archive, main → this branch): 3078.1 → 7914.2 kB, +4836.1 kB, nearly all Assets.car: the 23 fish 3921.7 kB, the 6 seasonal 882.4 kB, the 3 earlier designs 58.5 kB (flat colours compress; the gradients don't: CoreUI keeps each size as ARGB, lzfse). With the Spotlight, Settings and notification sizes too it was 10625.0 kB. What one iPhone downloads is far less: an assetutil thinning of Assets.car for phone @3x (an estimate, not an App Store export report) puts the app at 4194.2 kB, +1141.5 kB over main's 3052.7. Then their previews in the picker, since an icon set doesn't load as an image: the 33 icons at 64 pt @2x and @3x, stored lossy, +297.5 kB of Assets.car (actool on the previews alone: lossy 308 kB, lossless 1178 kB, SVG 2233 kB, as actool keeps three pictures of an SVG beside it); measured 8229.9 kB with them and #445, thinned 4395.5 kB; CI measured 8247.2 kB (run 41769239945). Then the owner's new default icon (2026-11-04), the round fish with leaf fins, its 1024 in three looks (drawn, dark, tinted), each quantized (pngquant, dithered: gradients stored as they are cost twice as much), for iPhone and iPad: 492.8, 178.2 and 67.4 kB of Assets.car where the AT's one look was 50.6; its home-screen PNGs beside the app 49.2 kB (8.5); three more alternates (a book-page fin, a magnifier, the AT) and their previews about 358 kB. Measured 9367.4 kB, thinned 4933.5 kB. Then the 34 alternates drawn by app-icons.py quantized the same way (2026-11-04; not the AT): Assets.car 6243.8 → 3171.9 kB (actool on the catalog), an estimated 6295.5 kB, thinned 4211.8 kB. CI measured 6281.1 kB on main a4f53d8d (run 41951958864), where main itself read 8266.2 kB (run 41951761406): 1985.1 kB less than main; then 6523.7 kB rebased onto main 476c1341 (run 41969877502), the 242.6 kB more being main's own changes; then 6617.6 kB rebased onto main ddcf4d8f (run 42064452472), where main read 8602.6 kB (run 42054701917, on e4311783, the same app): 1985.0 kB less than main. Rebased onto main 8d48d7d6, whose #536 read 0.9 kB over main (run 42064244145), 6618.5 kB; then onto main d5cc7895, whose #479 (fish ID) added 210.9 kB on one Mac: 6829.4 kB. Budget: 6829.4 kB ×1.1, rounded to 5 kB (main's was 9070; 3255 before the icons)
